verdict.rationale: A machine-readable API description, such as official type definitions or a structured API schema, is a fair ask for a JavaScript library, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no such spec: all OpenAPI/Swagger probe paths return 404. The llms.txt and llms-full.txt files are prose documentation, not a structured spec. TypeScript typings exist only as community-maintained @types/three, which the maintainer does not maintain.
